acceptance.assertion: In tests/session-provider-registry.test.ts and tests/supervised-session-herdr.test.ts: the config-visible registry lists exactly herdr and herdr-core; herdr requires HERDR_ENV=1 and non-empty HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID and declares roles.executor with claude-code, pi, antigravity, workspace local_path, find_by_key true, and exit_proof true; herdr-core declares roles.executor hosts [] and exit_proof false; runSessionCli builds adapters from the registry and rejects --provider fake or --provider unknown_name with invalid_input.

In tests/session-provider-registry.test.ts: resolveSessionProvider for role executor with ["herdr", "herdr-core"] selects herdr when HERDR_ENV=1 and HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID=ws1, refuses lane_session_unavailable listing both providers and recoveries when HERDR_ENV is unset or HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID is empty, selects herdr-core outside Herdr when an injected descriptor admits pi while refusing claude-code, skips descriptors with find_by_key false (reason no find_by_key), and invokes zero adapter factory, probe, or createSession calls.

In tests/supervised-session-conformance.test.ts, across every registered descriptor under its fake CLI and fake: createSession with session_key binds it into session identity and rejects uppercase, underscore, empty, or 65-char keys with invalid_input; findSession returns that handle or not_found; repeated closeWithProof(handle, session_key) calls return the same exited proof bound to handle and session_key while a mismatched session_key returns not_owned; an injected descriptor claiming find_by_key or exit_proof without implementing the method fails.

In tests/supervised-session-herdr.test.ts: createSession with session_key writes [imm:<session_key>] into the tab label; herdrAgentName uses the trailing 12 characters so two sibling keys sharing a 20-character prefix produce distinct agent names; findSession queries herdr tab list --workspace; closeWithProof verifies live [imm:<session_key>] before closing pane and tab, returns exited proof on crash re-entry when pane get is pane_not_found and tab list finds no matching key, and refuses not_owned without closing when a live tab carries another key. Existing herdr-core and advisory tests pass.

docs/reference/supervised-session-port.md, docs/adr/0038-supervised-session-port.md, and CONTEXT.md document resolveSessionProvider, session_key, findSession, closeWithProof, and lane_session_unavailable.
Claude bundle, Antigravity artifact, dist reference mirrors, and repository typecheck are current.

In tests/supervised-session-boundary.test.ts: runtime/session/ imports only its own modules and node:* builtins, session imports stay inside allowed callers, and no runtime file outside runtime/session/ compares a provider name literal.

scope_size_reason: Role-indexed provider descriptors, the Port primitives honoring them (session_key, findSession, closeWithProof) across herdr, herdr-core, and fake, and the conformance suite verifying declaration-to-adapter parity form one atomic session contract alongside its ADR and reference docs.
